profile.address: 1231 Comstock Street, Santa Clara County, CA
profile.reading: Prime SANTA CLARA DATA CENTER sits at 1231 Comstock Street in Santa Clara County, California, internally coded SJC04 by the operator, one of three separate buildings that make up Prime Data Centers Silicon Valley portfolio in this dataset. Per Prime own site, SJC04 is designed for 9 megawatts of capacity across 112,000 square feet and is listed in development status rather than fully operational or leased. Prime own Silicon Valley locations page describes the broader portfolio there as five buildings totaling 57 megawatts, 540,000 square feet, and 17 data halls across 13 acres, of which SJC04 is one component alongside the separately mapped SJC02 building roughly 150 meters away on the same street, and SJC03 about a kilometer away on Martin Avenue. No tenant is disclosed for SJC04, and no year-built figure is published. Prime Data Centers was founded in 2017 in California and is now headquartered at 400 North Ervay Street in Dallas, Texas. The company describes itself on its own site as majority founder-owned, a description that does not claim institutional private equity or infrastructure fund majority ownership, though it does not rule out unnamed minority capital partners either. Founder and CEO Nicholas Laag leads the company alongside CFO Ulrich Pelz and other named executives. Prime describes its overall footprint as 28 data centers across 13 campuses with a stated pipeline exceeding 4 gigawatts, spanning Austin, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, Phoenix, Sacramento, and Silicon Valley in North America, plus Frankfurt and Madrid in Europe and a newly announced site in Esbjerg, Denmark. An SEC filing from an unrelated company, UGI Corporation, disclosed a 2026 strategic partnership with Prime to develop natural gas supply infrastructure in Pennsylvania, indicating Prime energy-sourcing relationships extend beyond its data center markets.
profile.research_note: 9 MW / 112,000 sqft / development status for SJC04 sourced to Prime own Silicon Valley locations page, matched to this address via coordinate resolution. UGI Corp 8-K (May 2026) confirming a Prime/UGI Pennsylvania natural-gas infrastructure partnership included as independent third-party corroboration that Prime is a real, active company with genuine energy-infrastructure dealings.

reading.body:
Prime SANTA CLARA (SJC04) is one of three buildings in Prime's Silicon Valley portfolio, rated at 9 megawatts of IT capacity across 112,000 square feet in Santa Clara County. The facility is listed in development status, meaning it is not yet fully operational or leased. At a typical AI training density of 40 kilowatts per rack, 9 megawatts translates to roughly 225 racks, though this assumes the full capacity is allocated to accelerator workloads and does not account for infrastructure overhead.

The campus qualifies to host security-sensitive workloads under SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 compliance. These certifications indicate readiness for financial services, payments, and regulated data processing but do not constrain the facility to those uses. No tenant or operational timeline is published.

SJC04 ranks third by published megawatts in California, behind only two larger facilities, in a state where 103 data centers are mapped but only 11 have published capacity figures totaling 365 megawatts. The facility is one component of Prime's stated 4-gigawatt pipeline across 28 data centers on 13 campuses, though pipeline figures do not indicate commissioning dates or customer commitments and should be interpreted as development ambition rather than near-term supply.
